sloka: दक्षः प्रगल्भो द्युतिमान् महा बल पराक्रमः ।भ्राता विवासितो वीर राज्य हेतो महात्मना ॥३-७२-१४॥
transliteration: dakṣaḥ pragalbho dyutimān mahā bala parākramaḥ ।bhrātā vivāsito vīra rājya heto mahātmanā ॥3-72-14॥

translations.english: He is efficient, eloquent, brilliant. He is mighty and strong. (But) he is banished by his brother from the kingdom, O Rama
